description: Payroll Alert Triage Skill Evaluation Cases

evaluation_cases.case_name: Basic Alert Triage - PCC Alert Export
evaluation_cases.description: Test basic alert triage with 50 alerts from a standard payroll control center alert export. The input has the standard 5-column format (Validation Rule, Employee Name, Personnel Number, Processor, Status). Validates that the AI correctly classifies, prioritizes, and routes alerts based on Validation Rule names.
expected_outputs: Alerts classified by AI into domains (Data Quality, Compliance, Processing, Financial) based on Validation Rule names
Priorities assigned P1-P4 based on rule severity, blocking status, alert volume, and deadline proximity
Root causes grouped by Validation Rule for batch processing
SLA deadlines calculated for each priority level
Unassigned 'Open' alerts flagged for processor assignment

validation_criteria.description: At least 90% of alerts correctly classified into the right domain
Blocking rules = P1/P2, non-blocking = P3/P4 (adjusted by deadline and volume)
Alerts routed to teams with appropriate expertise for the domain
At least one batch processing opportunity identified

sample_assertions: 'Employees with missing tax withholding data' alerts classified as Data Quality
'Employees with garnishment order validation errors' alerts classified as Compliance
'Employees with duplicate wage type entries' alerts classified as Processing
'Employees with negative net pay results' alerts prioritized as P1/P2
Same Validation Rule alerts grouped together for batch resolution
Open alerts flagged for immediate attention over Resolved/Solution Applied
Unassigned alerts identified for processor assignment

evaluation_cases.description: Test batch processing recommendations and workload distribution from alert export. Validates that AI can identify efficiency gains from grouping alerts by Validation Rule and rebalancing across processors.
expected_outputs: All 50 test alerts processed and categorized
Batch processing groups identified by Validation Rule
Workload distribution analyzed across existing processors
Time savings estimates for batch resolution

validation_criteria.description: Identified batch opportunities save > 30% resolution time
Current processor assignments analyzed with rebalancing suggestions
At least 5 alerts identified as P1/P2 for urgent handling
At least 5 distinct Validation Rule groups identified

sample_assertions: 'Employees with missing tax withholding data' alerts batched together
'Employees with invalid bank account details' alerts routed to same team for batch processing
'Employees with duplicate wage type entries' alerts identified as batch opportunity
Unassigned 'Open' alerts flagged for processor assignment
Processor workload assessed based on existing assignments
Workload distributed across Data, Compliance, Processing, Finance teams

evaluation_cases.description: Test conversational alert triage where user describes alert situation without providing XLSX file. Validates ability to classify and prioritize based on natural language description.
evaluation_cases.conversation_scenario: User describes: 'We have a batch of missing tax data alerts affecting 8 employees in our biweekly payroll. Payroll runs in 3 days. We also have 2 negative net pay alerts that need immediate attention. How should we prioritize?'
expected_outputs: Missing Tax Data alerts classified as Data Quality, P2 (4-hour resolution)
Negative Net Pay alerts classified as Financial, P1 (1-hour resolution)
Routing: Tax Data → Data Operations Team, Net Pay → Finance Team
Batch processing recommendation for 8 missing tax data alerts
Escalation path for P1 negative net pay alerts
Timeline recommendation: resolve P1 within 1 hour, P2 within 4 hours

validation_criteria.description: Negative net pay correctly assessed as P1, tax data as P2
Correct teams recommended for each alert type
Batch processing strategy provided for 8 tax data alerts
Clear escalation path provided for P1 alerts

sample_assertions: Negative Net Pay alerts assigned P1 (1-hour resolution)
Missing Tax Data alerts assigned P2 (4-hour resolution)
Batch tax data processing saves 2+ hours
Recommended escalation for negative net pay immediately
Data Operations Team recommended for tax data
Finance & Reconciliation Team recommended for net pay
Recommendation to defer non-critical work during 3-day deadline

test_data_files.description: Test alert export matching the standard payroll control center alert management view format. Contains 50 alerts with the standard 5-column layout: Validation Rule, Employee Name, Personnel Number, Processor, Status. Uses standard alert statuses (Open, Solution Applied, Resolved, Forwarded) and realistic processor IDs.
Python script to generate additional test alert data matching standard 5-column alert export format

success_criteria.overall: All three test cases pass validation criteria
success_criteria.case_1: Basic triage correctly classifies, prioritizes, and routes 50 alerts from 5-column export
success_criteria.case_2: Batch processing analysis identifies >30% efficiency gains from grouping by Validation Rule
success_criteria.case_3: Conversational triage provides correct priority and routing recommendations
success_criteria.output_quality: Clear, actionable triage recommendations with team assignments and SLA timelines

notes: Input file uses 5-column standard format: Validation Rule, Employee Name, Personnel Number, Processor, Status
Severity is derived from the Validation Rule classification (blocking vs. non-blocking rules)
Domain classification maps Validation Rule names to Data Quality / Compliance / Processing / Financial
Alert statuses are standard values: Open, Solution Applied, Resolved, Forwarded
Batch opportunities identified by grouping same Validation Rule alerts
Conversational test validates skill's ability to work without file input
